description.en:
Operator Almond has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for assault following physical coercion of enemy proximity.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Specialist Operator during field operations to exercise Hookmaster responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.
description.zh:
干员杏仁擅长将敌人拖拽至身边后进行攻击
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为特种干员，行使钩索师职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en: 'Liskarm, what's this cake doing here?' 'From HR, for the newcomer.' 'Oh, you mean that engineering specialist they got? I think she was fresh out of college? We haven't had new meat in forever—don't you wanna mess with her a little? Ahah, there we are, I'll just hide the cake in this drawer for now.' 'Knock it off, Franka, she's already here—Come in.' 'Sorry, let me just put my stuff down. Is this the BPRS division?' '...Laura Arias?' 'Yep.' 'Laura, we'll be conducting an interview for BPRS now. Do you understand?' 'Franka—' 'Interview? Don't think anyone told me... Well, whatever, no problem. Go ahead, ma'am.' 'Okay, listen close, first question—what the hell's this giant thing you brought with you?' 'Huh, what? That sure is some question... It's the 'Traction Model Long-Distance Transporter Prototype', and it was my capstone project too, but... after packing up for Blacksteel, I made a few improvements to adapt it to the security field. But continuing the R&D takes funds, and applying for funds requires more experimental data, so I'm applying here... It'll be easier to explain if you just give it a try. Either of you ladies interested?' 'Liskarm, how about you—' 'I imagine you're dying to try it, aren't you, Franka?' 'Here, hold this grip, and be careful.' 'Oftentimes, security work means the enemy's some distance away. After modifications, this piece of gear's now able to drag anything or anyone right up next to you. Just pull the trigger.' 'Whewww~. That's a lot more stable than any regular hookshot, but this sort of thing is pretty common.' 'Right, that's the improved basic functionality, and what I'm currently researching lies a little elsewhere. You know, there's times you're in complex terrain and it's hard to get anywhere with your average hookshot, but these mechanical claws can grab onto most anything... Go on, try that out too. Press here and it'll switch modes.' 'That's pretty handy! Hey, Liskarm, I can grab the you-know-what...' 'Just use it like you used the other mode. But be careful, it's not fully calibrated yet, so—' Crash! And with that sudden sound, Franka vanishes from where she stood, appearing in an instant on the other side of the room. The cabinet topples over with a colossal thud, and cake and icing splatter all over the floor. Naturally, Franka's face gets the most. 'Don't fire it at anything unfixed, since it'll drag you there pretty rapidly...' Liskarm forces her facial muscles to stay put, and turns to an apologetic-looking Laura. 'I suppose we don't have a welcoming cake anymore. That concludes the interview. Welcome to BPRS, Laura. Your new life begins here.'
description.zh:
“雷蛇，这儿怎么有个蛋糕？”
“人事部送来给新人的。”
“哦，你是说派来当随队工程专员的新人吧，好像是个刚毕业的学生？好久没来新人了，你不想逗逗她吗？啊哈，有了，我先把蛋糕藏到柜子里。”
“芙兰卡，不许乱来，人已经到了——请进。”
“抱歉，我先把东西放下来。这里是B.P.R.S.部门吗？”
“……罗拉·阿里亚斯？”
“是。”
“罗拉，接下来会开始一场B.P.R.S.的面试，你清楚吧？”
“芙兰卡——”
“面试？好像没人告诉我……算了，没关系，请开始吧。”
“听好啦，第一个问题，你带来的这个大家伙是什么？”
“欸欸？要问这个……它叫‘牵引式远距离搬运原型机’，本来是我的毕业设计，不过……准备来黑钢以后，我做了一些使它适用于安保领域的改进。但继续研发需要经费，申请经费要更多试验数据，所以我申请到你们这儿……上手体验会直观一点，两位要试试吗？”
“雷蛇，不如你……”
“芙兰卡应该很想尝试，对吧？”
“给，握住这个把手，注意安全。”
“安保工作中经常会和敌人相隔较远的距离。经过改造后，这个设备能将远处的东西或者人直接扯过来。扣下扳机就好。”
“欸~比一般的钩索要稳得多，但这功能很常见吧。”
“是的，这是已经改好的基础功能，我目前在研究的是另一个方向。你们知道，在复杂的地形中普通的钩索很难起作用，而这个机械爪能抓住大部分物体……这个也试试吧，按这里就能切换模式。”
“还挺方便的！啊，雷蛇，我可以把那个抓来……”
“使用方法和刚刚的一样。要注意的是，由于还没调整好——”
“咣当！”
随着一声巨响，芙兰卡从原地消失，瞬间出现在了房间的另一边。柜子轰然倾倒，碎掉的蛋糕与奶油遍地都是。当然，最多的是在芙兰卡的脸上。
“别对着不稳的物体发射，它会拉着你快速移动……”
雷蛇强行控制住面部肌肉，转向面带歉意的罗拉。
“看来没有迎新蛋糕可以吃了。面试结束……欢迎来到B.P.R.S.，罗拉，你的新生活开始了。”
